Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#1 shadow — confrontation staged: repel + shove pointer, turbulence 0.15 (projection's disturbed field); the Christ-image sequence walks triangle → 'privatio boni' → a dimmed triangle (the exclusively luminous image meeting the argument that keeps evil's efficacy in view); the shadow disc grows as the world gives the rejected face back; Antichrist's ☹ brightens from excluded dim to compensatory red-brown. Duration 13.
#2 fishes — THE 3D SCENE. z is the age's layered time: the embracing double nearest (z +0.4, lived), Epiphanius's carried image at z +0.2, Pisces at middle depth (z 0), Leviathan behind (z −0.25), the precessional spring-point deepest (z −0.5, the slow astronomical background); auto-aeon, the journey's slowest sine LFO on circulation (rate 0.05 — the precession's pace). The double's sequence walks ◑◕ dim → ◑◕ bright → ◕ (bound, released, embraced, one); Leviathan's ring splits and becomes the golden disc of meal. Vortex + pulse pointer (the age's slow turning). Duration 14.
#3 alchemy — attraction worked: attract + pulse pointer (the magnet taught); the sea creature's ring heats grey → copper → shining gold; the Echeneis sequence walks 🧲 (the fish that halts ships) → 'magnet' (the operative understanding that draws the substance up) — the record's reversal in its own terms. Duration 13.
#4 quaternio — grid layout: the four states A/B/C/D held in their quadrants; the Anthropos sequence walks A → a → A (the record's own lower-case notation for transformation within the state); the diamonds' ring rotates 0 → 45 → 90 with the gold returning (each whole unfolding into four and passing onward, p.259); vortex + pulse pointer (the opus's circulation). Duration 13.
#5→0 return — the two successions walked ⇉ → generative → historical → ⇉ (what a work makes possible beside how its image becomes an inherited condition); attract at 0.3 — the revisable measure held without forcing; the register decision ⊘ and the uninstantiated ∅ kept exactly as the ledger holds them. Duration 15, the longest beat.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens with the ego meeting its excluded contrary — the shadow disc growing, the Christ-image dimming through its own argument, Antichrist brightening at the rim — and closes with the same structure at the scale of an age: de-monopolisation names what #1 lived, the inherited image becoming revisable, its exclusions active. The ego's ◉ of #1 returns as the eyewash ◉ of #3 — the same sign changed from centre-of-reference to capacity-to-see — and the dimmed Antichrist of #1 returns as the ⊘ register decision: the contrary held at the occupied slash without being installed. The ending qualifies the record's own line: a person who encounters the larger psychic field still has to judge and act; a culture that recognises the history of its image has acquired a responsibility to that history.
Human-amplified staging: the ledger's four appointments stay exactly as the record holds them — whole-before-fragments human-amplified: yes as design commitment; the exact symbolic appointment, the 1/1′ conjugate and the Pisces/precession appointment human-amplified: no (the #5→0 body and ⊘/∅ entities carry this). Mythemic verbs only: the images demonstrate and transform through the acts staged; no reusable index before the whole.
Automation: auto-aeon (#2, field.params.circulation sine at rate 0.05 — the precession's slow breath), tied to the record's aeonic office. Durations 13–15 and transitions 1.5–2.2: the fishes and the return held longest.

glyph_rationales.◉: at #1 the ego — centre of reference rooted beyond what it knows of itself; at #3 the eyewash — the preparation become the capacity to see.
glyph_rationales.☹: Antichrist — the compensatory counter-image of the contrary excluded from a representation of totality (chs. V).
glyph_rationales.privatio boni: the doctrine Jung argues against — evil as mere privation of good; his argument keeps evil's experience and efficacy in view.
glyph_rationales.♓: Pisces — the two fishes of the age, head to tail; the constellational image making contrary tendencies visible together while the age lives them successively.
glyph_rationales.♈: the precessional spring-point — expectation become a historical actor in Jung's interpretive chronology, deepest in the scene's depth as the slow astronomical background.
glyph_rationales.◑◕: the Pistis Sophia double — bound, released, embraced, one; doubling leading to reunion, an office distinct from Christ/Antichrist antagonism.
glyph_rationales.◕: the double become one — the reunion after release; nature rising from below met by spirit descending from above (Jung's mediated reading).
glyph_rationales.☵: Epiphanius's rite — the image carried up from the underground sanctuary and returned below; a pagan rite used as testimony, reception having already changed its office.
glyph_rationales.🧲: the Echeneis reversed — the small fish that halts ships; the attracting power that overcame human intention, now the object of the work.
glyph_rationales.magnet: the magnet taught — the doctrine or operative understanding that draws the hidden substance to the surface (chs. XI).
glyph_rationales.☿: Mercurius — substance and philosophy; the bright mercurial substance concealed within darkness, toward the lapis.
glyph_rationales.⚗: the aftermath — science born in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, the mother receding as outlived; the investigating psyche disappearing from objective knowledge's account.
glyph_rationales.A: Anthropos — the first major state of the quaternio (§§408–421).
glyph_rationales.a: the lower-case transformation within the state — the record's own notation for the inner articulation of a major state.
glyph_rationales.B: Shadow — the inserted modern reconstruction, declared by Jung absent from the Gnostic texts.
glyph_rationales.C: Physis/serpent — the chthonic approach to Nature in the downward balancing movement.
glyph_rationales.D: lapis — the transformed stone toward which the work proceeds.
glyph_rationales.↺: the ring returning through differentiation — an unconscious totality becoming a conscious one; solve et coagula, the circular opus.
glyph_rationales.⇉: the two successions held together — what a work makes possible beside how its image becomes an inherited condition.
glyph_rationales.generative: generative succession — what further life or capacity a work makes possible.
glyph_rationales.historical: historical succession — how an achieved image becomes an inherited condition and later encounters its contrary or transformation.
glyph_rationales.⊘: the register decision — Christ/Antichrist held at the occupied slash after the native derivation; no exact QL coordinate assigned (human-amplified: no).
glyph_rationales.∅: the uninstantiated indexes — Christ, Antichrist, fishes, alchemy, aeon: every later use must returns-to this complete whole and preserve its particular action.
